Return named adoption benchmark scenarios

Source: R/benchmark_comparators.R
adoption_benchmark_scenarios.Rd

adoption_benchmark_scenarios() defines a small, opinionated benchmark plan for comparing gamlss.longitudinal with GEE/GLMM/GAM defaults. The scenarios are designed to be executable through run_adoption_benchmarks() while also documenting the applied claim each scenario is meant to test.

Usage

adoption_benchmark_scenarios(scenarios = NULL)

Arguments

scenarios

Optional character vector of scenario names to keep.

Value

A data frame with one row per benchmark scenario.
